title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff ordering during regional failover
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: During a regional outage we observed SLO enforcer backoff timers and ordering incorrectly interact with the regional failover path, causing cascading load-shedding and uneven traffic distribution. This caused higher tail latency and unnecessary circuit-breaker tripping for healthy regions. This hotfix fixes the backoff ordering race, tightens hysteresis, and adds defensive checks during failover. Changes are intentionally focused and gated behind a feature flag so we can roll back quickly.
commits: fix(slo-enforcer): ensure deterministic backoff ordering by sorting candidate regions before applying backoff (Maya Chen)
fix(slo-enforcer): add guard to skip backoff update if failover token present; reduce jitter window during failover (Maya Chen)
test(slo-enforcer): add regression tests for backoff ordering + simulated regional failover scenarios (Maya Chen)
patch_summary:
- Deterministic ordering: sort candidate regions by stable id before computing/merging backoff state.
- Failover guard: if region is in active failover state, apply reduced jitter and skip aggressive backoff merges.
- Hysteresis: increase minimum hold time after backoff to prevent thrash when nodes flapping.
- Metrics: expose backoff_applied{region,reason} and add alerting tweaks to avoid noisy alerts during coordinated failovers.
- Tests: unit + integration simulation of 3-region failover sequence; added deterministic time source for tests.
review_comments: Diego Alvarez: Can you walk through the ordering decision? Why sort by region id vs. last-updated timestamp?

Maya Chen: Sorting by stable region id ensures deterministic merges across replicas; timestamps were a source of non-determinism during clock skew in incidents. Added comments in backoff_manager.go explaining tradeoffs.
Priya Patel: The increased hold time might delay recovery in small blips. Can we gate via feature flag?
Maya Chen: Yes, changes are behind slo_enforcer_backoff feature flag (deploy/feature-flags). Default for now preserves prior values; rollout will gradually enable for staging then prod.
Lucas Nguyen: CI/integration test flaked once on e2e - looks like a race in test harness. Please add deterministic clock (done) and re-run CI.
Maya Chen: Added deterministic clock in tests and extended harness timeout; CI re-ran and passed.
testing_notes: Local: ran slo-enforcer unit + integration harness with simulated failover; deterministic time source used for reproducibility. Staging: deployed feature flag enabled in us-west-2 staging cluster and ran 3-region synthetic failover; observed stable backoff ordering and no extra circuit-breaker tripping. Load test: 2x baseline traffic sustained without increased tail latency.
rollout_plan: 1) Merge to main and ship feature-flag off. 2) Enable flag in staging for 24h, run synthetic failover and load tests. 3) Canary enable in 5% of prod traffic (single region) for 2h, monitor backoff_applied and SLO error budget burn. 4) Gradually increase to 100% over 6 hours if metrics are green. Automated rollback: feature flag off or revert via emergency rollback playbook.
release_notes: Fixes a race in SLO enforcer backoff ordering that could lead to cascading load-shedding during regional failover. Improves stability and reduces noisy alerts during failovers. Backed by tests and staged behind a feature flag.
post_merge_actions: Create a Linear task to monitor SLO error budget for 48h post-rollout (ENG-2734), schedule on-call runbook review, and update docs/playbook with the new metrics names.
